mapper.sql: select id, user_id, title, create_time, update_time from law_chat_session
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by update_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into law_chat_session (user_id, title, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from law_chat_session where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select:
select s.id, s.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, s.title, (select count(*) from law_chat_message m where m.session_id = s.id) as message_count, (select count(*) from law_chat_message m where m.session_id = s.id and m.status = 'failed') as failed_count, coalesce((select sum(m.total_tokens) from law_chat_message m where m.session_id = s.id and m.role = 'assistant'), 0) as total_tokens, coalesce(round((select avg(m.ttft_ms) from law_chat_message m where m.session_id = s.id and m.role = 'assistant' and m.ttft_ms is not null)), 0) as avg_ttft_ms, coalesce((select sum(json_length(m.tool_calls_json)) from law_chat_message m where m.session_id = s.id and m.role = 'assistant' and m.tool_calls_json is not null), 0) as tool_call_count, s.create_time, s.update_time from law_chat_session s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id
and s.user_id = #{userId}
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
and s.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and s.update_time >= #{beginTime}
and s.update_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day)
order by s.update_time desc, s.id desc
